name: solidity-share-payment-splitter
title: Weighted token payment splitter
description: Immutable weighted ERC20 revenue allocation with cumulative entitlement accounting and pull-based releases.
assumptions: Shares and payees are immutable after deployment. Direct token donations count as revenue. Integer rounding dust can remain until later funding. Assumes non-rebasing standard ERC20; balance decreases outside releases would violate cumulative accounting.
